title: Research: minimize dirty idempotent basis preparation
body:
## Summary

```diff
- PR3137 two-star scalar round trip: 2(A+B-2) whole-array XORs
+ Optimal scalar preparation and inverse: 2A+2B-c-3 whole-array XORs
```

Here A=wt(u), B=wt(v), c=wt(u&v), and v^T u=1 over F2. A coordinate-color potential proves the exact preparation distance for every finite role count, including arbitrary restored dirty spectators. A three-XOR elimination attains it. The finite-array Q8 compiler saves exactly c-1 whole-array XORs; the all-shared three-role noncentral action costs 66B rather than 82B bit XORs.

This is a local compiler improvement. Actual recursive caller, routing, ownership and complete supplier costs remain open. No formal Q8 paid-word tariff, new kappa, selected-frontier update, independent human review or formal proof-kernel acceptance is claimed. Credits Arham Tahir/PR3137, ywz65 and the retained Q8/register lineage.

[Canonical investigation](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2034#discussioncomment-19009906). Proof, exact source pins, executable compiler, evidence and replay are in `research/optimal-dirty-preparation`.

## Evidence

- **Before:** the source-pinned two-star preparation passes the complete dirty-operator check but loses the independent minimum-distance test at shared support three. **After:** all 43,435 idempotents through eight roles match independent multisource BFS; 18,831 improve.
- **Before:** the noncentral three-role data invoice is 82B. **After:** the emitted schedule gives 66B; 21,360 full dirty-array fixtures check 972,864 input columns and inverses against a separate Hamilton oracle.
- Registered CPython 3.12.15 replay, six behavioral groups, scoped Ruff and formatting pass. Actual optimized CLI controls reject changed costs/types, duplicate keys, source drift, missing sources and wrong operators. Committed-byte/source-history and Git-free export replay pass.

```sh
python3.12 -W error -B scripts/research_package.py \
  --package research/optimal-dirty-preparation
```

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way. One new isolated package; no predecessor or selected source is changed.

**Blast Radius:** local. The universal claim is limited to scalar row-XOR preparation. The full data bill belongs to the stated conjugate-once/action/inverse-restore compiler.
